facts.fact: The ONI launched special operations on 9 September 2026 to issue the AES biometric identity card (CIB-AES) nationwide, with enrolment open from age 5 to 16 September.
The ONI director general says the office is switching to a new platform, while enrolment is mostly on paper for now, with about 500 centres to get mobile digital kits by end 2026.
